name: lockfile-check
description: Check an npm lock file for supply-chain risks before a Node.js back end is built or deployed: packages from git, plain URLs or local folders, http downloads, other registries, missing or weak integrity hashes, install scripts, a lock file out of sync with package.json, and more. Reads files only, never runs npm, no dependencies.
author: INNERLUXES <info@innerluxes.dev>
